svg.title: Recommendations and guidance
svg.desc: What helps a person decide where to look or what to do? Attention and warnings, previews, recommendations, and procedural or corrective guidance contribute different information to an action. Source illustration: The study contrasts fixed energy-saving tips with a conversational condition that elicits household context.
